speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram
text: asked	the Minister for Communications and Information what steps has the Government taken to encourage more production companies to utilise the state-of-the-art facilities at Mediapolis@one-north.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The soundstages have been well-utilised by local and regional large-scale television productions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The main facility in Mediapolis under the Infocomm Media Development Authority's (IMDA’s) purview is PIXEL Studios.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: IMDA also organises a slate of programmes for content creators to learn from experienced local and international industry leaders.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: These events range from networking sessions and video production clinics to workshops and talks on immersive media trends and technologies.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: IMDA has also opened up PIXEL Studios for independent digital content creators to use the facilities for free.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Some examples of the facilities available are audio and video recording suites, post-editing suites, thematic areas and backdrops, as well as filming equipment.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: All these facilities serve to meet the basic production needs of content creators.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: So far, the response from industry users has been positive.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Over the past six months, about a dozen productions by content creators have taken place at PIXEL Studios.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Obtaining permissions to film at some locations in Singapore may be a challenge for some production companies.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Thus, IMDA has established agreements with various building owners in the one-north precinct for a higher level of openness towards production companies which may be interested to use some locations for their filming.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: This supports small-size film productions by helping them gain easier access to film at these areas.
